A.title: Will Trump resign by December 31, 2026?
A.yes_proposition: By December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, Donald Trump announces that he has resigned or will resign the presidency, before an event makes such an announcement impossible.

B.title: Trump out as President before 2027?
B.yes_proposition: By December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, Donald Trump permanently ceases to be US President, or his resignation or permanent removal is announced; sustained Section 4 removal qualifies and impeachment without removal does not.
